purpose: Mechanism (exact guidance decomposition of the endpoint drift) and confirmation of a guidance-aware, risk-controlled handover rule on development speakers not used by EXP-012..EXP-018
lemma1: x1hat(t_j) - x1hat(t_{j-1}) = (1 - t_j)(v_j - v_{j-1}); v = c + w g; g = c - u; d_j^2 = p^c_j + p^g_j + p^x_j (generated frames)

data.dev: first 60 development speakers by utterance ID x ['clean', 'noisy15', 'gauss18', 'gauss20', 'gauss22', 'gauss25']; labels: EXP-018 steps1to8.csv
data.fresh: development speakers 61..100 by utterance ID x ['clean', 'noisy15', 'gauss18', 'gauss20', 'gauss22', 'gauss25']; used before only in EXP-001 (all1000, Steps 4/5/6/8, clean and noisy15)
data.ood: the fresh speakers x ['reverb03', 'reverb09', 'telephone'] (+ ['babble15', 'babble20'] when a DEMAND track is given)

loss.definition: L = min(1, max(dWER_hinge, dSIM_hinge, dUTMOS_hinge [clean prompts only])) vs the grid reference, hinge(x) = max(0, (x - m) / b)

safe_label.definition: dWER <= 0.01, dSIM >= -0.015 and (clean) dUTMOS >= -0.15 vs the reference

signal_family.A_over_gc0: guidance-normalized action: A_k / gc_0, with gc_0 = ||g_0||_M / ||c_0||_M at t_0 = 0
signal_family.guid_action: guidance action: sum_{j<=k} sqrt(p^g_j) (cumulative guidance-induced endpoint change)
signal_family.cond_action: conditional action: sum_{j<=k} sqrt(p^c_j) (cumulative conditional-velocity endpoint change)

selection_rule: on dev only: the family member with the highest mean AUC over 16-grid steps [1, 2, 3, 4] for the safe label (ties: family order)

policies.gpc: selected signal; candidate thresholds ordered by the Pareto marginal-efficiency path (each move lowers mean NFE, chosen by NFE drop / (loss increase + eps)), built on 1/3 of the calibration speakers; the stopping index chosen on the other 2/3 by conformal risk control on the speaker-level monotone envelope loss: largest t with (1 + sum_s max_{t'<=t} L_s(t')) / (n + 1) <= alpha = 0.05
policies.gpc_A: signal ablation: A_k instead of the selected signal
policies.gpc_greedy: path ablation: stage-by-stage greedy path instead of the Pareto marginal-efficiency path
policies.gpc_nocrc: calibration ablation: path built and stopped on all calibration data at mean loss <= alpha, no split

baselines.stac: STAC: Stage-Wise Trajectory Action Cascade (A_k = sum_{j=1}^k d_j >= lambda_k, NO SNR!)
baselines.crc_stac: CRC-STAC: Conformal Risk-Controlled Trajectory Action Cascade (alpha=0.05, NO SNR!)
baselines.snr_casc: Control: Stage-Wise SNR Cascade (S_hat >= theta_k, matched DOF!)

hypotheses.H1: max Lemma-1 residual <= 1e-3 over every telemetry row and step (pass/fail)
hypotheses.H2: guidance share S_g = sum(dp^g + dp^x / 2) / sum(d(d^2)) of the noisy-minus-clean change at steps [2, 3, 4] (paired by utterance), speaker bootstrap 95% CI: 'guidance-driven' if the lower bound > 0.5, 'conditional-driven' if the upper bound < 0.5, else 'mixed' (descriptive, reported for dev and fresh)
hypotheses.H3: on fresh: mean AUC over steps [1, 2, 3, 4] of the selected signal minus that of A_k, speaker bootstrap (1000) 95% CI lower bound > 0 (pass/fail); the same against prompt SNR is secondary
hypotheses.H4: on fresh, g16_floor, gpc calibrated once on dev: (a) TOST p < 0.05 on WER (1 pp) and SIM (0.02) vs the reference; (b) mean clean-prompt UTMOS drop <= 0.1; (c) test risk (mean speaker-level loss) <= alpha; (d) NFE saving >= STAC's saving - 1% or STAC fails (a) or (b). Necessity (descriptive): each ablation either saves at least 1 pp less or fails (a)-(c)
hypotheses.H5: on OOD fresh cases: gpc's mean dWER vs the reference has a speaker-bootstrap 95% upper bound <= +0.01 and gpc saves at least as much as the Stage-Wise SNR Cascade (pass/fail)

evidence_status: development evidence; not the thesis's frozen held-out evaluation (EVAL-001/EVAL-002)
